rationale: Thomas brings staff-level ML expertise from Intuit focused on ml-applications, while Udula is an early-stage ML engineer at RBC Borealis with hands-on experience across ml-infra and robotics. They can exchange perspectives on scaling ML systems—Thomas from a mature product perspective and Udula from building infrastructure and robotics projects with a broad stack (Python, TypeScript, C++).
intro_message: Thomas, meet Udula Abeykoon — an ML engineer at RBC Borealis working on ml-infra and robotics who'd benefit from your applied ML experience at Intuit.
